name: flow-reader
description: Tauri desktop EPUB and TXT reader based on pacexy/flow

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests .agents/skills vite.config.ts prettier.config.ts eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests .agents/skills package.json vite.config.ts prettier.config.ts eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests .agents/skills package.json vite.config.ts prettier.config.ts eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts index.html
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/theme-tokens.test.ts && node tests/unit/reader-optimization.test.ts && node tests/unit/body-text.test.ts && node tests/unit/note-links.test.ts && vitest run
scripts.check:base: pnpm test:unit && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.check:extended: pnpm --filter @flow/epubjs test && pnpm rust:format:check && pnpm rust:lint && pnpm rust:test && pnpm test:integration
scripts.check:full: pnpm check:base && pnpm check:extended && pnpm build
scripts.check:release: pnpm check:base && pnpm check:extended && pnpm tauri:build
